about: The Metal engine's run settings on an Apple-Silicon Mac: what setup.py writes into strata-<model>.json there. These are the measured ones (README, docs/MAC.md): all experts resident in the Mac's memory and decoded on the GPU as one graph (--mmap-experts --no-prefill-borrow), 1,024-token prompt chunks, FP16 KV, the MTP layer loaded (the server needs it) but no drafts (--mtp-max-t 1 --suffix-draft 0: on the M2 Max the checking cost more than it saved). {pack} {gguf} {ple} {profile} {mtp} {context} are filled in by setup.
measured_on: Apple M2 Max (38-core GPU, 96 GB), macOS 26.5, Xcode 26.1, IQ2_XS
evidence: bench/results/2026-10-03-metal-readme/ (24 tok/s writing, 196 tok/s reading a 30,000-token prompt)
